title: Long-term micro/nanoplastic ingestion promotes sepsis by worsening kidney damage: a transcriptomics and metabolomics study
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,3957-3974
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01206B, Paper
Yutao Zha, Yao Cheng, Sijie Yu, Yuanfang Cheng, Jinsong Wang, Xiaojie Han, Yayun Wu, Heng Wang, Nian Liu, Ming Fang, Min Shao
Our study finds that smaller-sized plastics affect the survival of septic mice by damaging and aggravating kidney injury. Multi-omics analysis has revealed that five genes—Srm, Pycr2, Arg2, Asns, and Psat1—may play key roles in this process.
